info.title: ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs
info.description: API Reference Guide for the ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs

get.description: Retrieves the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules based on the specified rule type. To learn more, see About Data at Rest Scanning DLP.

post.description: Adds a new SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule. To learn more, see Configuring the Data at Rest Scanning DLP Policy.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Information about the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule

get.description: Retrieves all the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rules
Retrieves the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule based on the specified ID

put.description: Updates the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule based on the specified ID

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Information about the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule

delete.description: Deletes the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule based on the specified ID

get.description: Retrieves the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Malware Detection rules based on the specified rule type. To learn more, see About Data at Rest Scanning Malware Detection.

parameters.name: body

get.description: Retrieves all the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Malware Detection rules

put.description: Updates the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Malware Detection rule based on the specified ID

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Information about the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Malware Detection rule

delete.description: Deletes the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Malware Detection rule based on the specified ID

get.description: Retrieves the domain profile summary. To learn more about domain profiles, navigate to the 'Domain Profiles' section from About Email Profiles.
Retrieves the templates for the tombstone file created when a file is quarantined. To learn more, see About Quarantine Tombstone File Templates.
Retrieves the email labels generated for the SaaS Security policies in a user's email account. To learn more, see About Email Labels.
Retrieves the tags used in the policy rules associated with a tenant, based on the tenant ID.
Retrieves information about the SaaS application tenant. To learn more, see About SaaS Application Tenants.

parameters.name: activeOnly
parameters.description: Indicates that the tenant is in use. Policies are enforced for this SaaS application.

parameters.name: scanConfigTenantsOnly
parameters.description: Specifies the tenant for which the scan is already configured

parameters.name: includeBucketReadyS3Tenants
parameters.description: For the AWS S3 SaaS application, this parameter indicates that the buckets have been read and are ready for use in policies and scan configurations.

parameters.name: filterByFeature
parameters.description: Filters the SaaS application tenant by feature

get.description: Retrieves the SaaS Security Scan Configuration information. To learn more, see About SaaS Security Scan Configuration.
Retrieves the validation status of the SaaS application tenant based on the tenant ID

type.description: The type of SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule

id.description: System-generated identifier for the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule

order.description: Order of rule execution with respect to other SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rules

rank.description: Admin rank that is assigned to this rule. Mandatory when admin rank-based access restriction is enabled.

cloudAppTenants.description: Name-ID pairs of the cloud application tenants for which the rule is applied. If the name-ID pairs of the cloud application tenants are not specified, the rule is applied to all tenants.

users.description: Name-ID pairs of users for which rule is applied. If not set, the rule is applied to all users.

groups.description: Name-ID pairs of groups for which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is applied for all groups.

departments.description: Name-ID pairs of departments for which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is applied to all departments.

dlpEngines.description: DLP engines whose violation is checked by this rule

action.description: The configured action for the policy rule

severity.description: The severity level of the incidents that match the policy rule

description.description: An admin editable text-based description of the rule

fileTypes.description: File types for which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is applied across all file types.

contentLocation.description: The location for the content that the Zscaler service inspects for sensitive data

domains.description: The domain for the external organization sharing the channel. This field is applicable only when you select CONTENT_LOCATION_SHARED_CHANNEL in the 'contentLocation' field.

objectTypes.description: List of object types for which the rule is applied

components.description: List of components for which the rule is applied. Zscaler service inspects these components for sensitive data.

buckets.description: The buckets for the Zscaler service to inspect for sensitive data

bucketOwner.description: A user who inspect their buckets for sensitive data. When you choose a user, their buckets are available in the Buckets field.

zscalerIncidentReceiver.description: The Zscaler Incident Receiver details. To learn more, see About Zscaler Incident Receiver.

externalAuditorEmail.description: Email address of the external auditor to whom the DLP email alerts are sent

auditor.description: Selects an auditor for the rule. If you do not select an auditor, notifications are not sent for this rule.

auditorNotification.description: Notification template used for DLP email alerts sent to the auditor

watermarkProfile.description: Watermark profile applied to the rule. To learn more, see Adding & Editing Watermark Profiles.

watermarkDeleteOldVersion.description: A Boolean value that specifies whether to delete an old version of the watermarked file

numberOfInternalCollaborators.description: Selects the number of internal collaborators for files that are shared with specific collaborators or are discoverable within an organization

numberOfExternalCollaborators.description: Selects the number of external collaborators for files that are shared with specific collaborators outside of an organization

fileSharingExpiryTimeType.description: Selects the file sharing expiration period

fileSharingExpiryTime.description: Specifies the custom expiration period, in epoch format. This field is applicable when you select OFLCASB_LINK_EXPIRY_TIME_PERIOD_CUSTOM_DATE in the fileSharingExpiryTimeType field.

recipient.description: Specifies if the email recipient is internal or external

lastModifiedTime.description: Timestamp of when the rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy.description: Admin user that last modified the rule

quarantineLocation.description: Location where all the quarantined files are moved and necessary actions are taken by either deleting or restoring the data

accessControl.description: Access privilege of this rule based on the admin's Role Based Authorization (RBA) state

redactionProfile.description: Name-ID of the redaction profile in the criteria

labels.description: Name-ID pairs of rule labels associated with the rule

casbEmailLabel.description: Name-ID of the email label associated with the rule

casbTombstoneTemplate.description: Name-ID of the quarantine tombstone template associated with the rule

includedDomainProfiles.description: Name-ID pairs of domain profiles included in the criteria for the rule

excludedDomainProfiles.description: Name-ID pairs of domain profiles excluded in the criteria for the rule

criteriaDomainProfiles.description: Name-ID pairs of domain profiles that are mandatory in the criteria for the rule

emailRecipientProfiles.description: Name-ID pairs of recipient profiles for which the rule is applied. The rule is applied only when there is at least one email recipient from outside an organization, and that recipient is not an external trusted user or is not using an external trusted domain.

includeCriteriaDomainProfile.description: If true, criteriaDomainProfiles is included as part of the criteria, else they are excluded from the criteria.

includeEmailRecipientProfile.description: If true, emailRecipientProfiles is included as part of the criteria, else they are excluded from the criteria.

devices.description: Name-ID pairs of devices for which rule must be applied. Specifies devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

deviceGroups.description: Name-ID pairs of device groups for which the rule must be applied. This field is applicable for devices that are managed using Zscaler Client Connector. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

deviceTrustLevels.description: List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

withoutContentInspection.description: If true, Content Matching is set to None

entityGroups.description: Name-ID pairs of entity groups that are part of the rule criteria

includeEntityGroups.description: If true, entityGroups is included as part of the criteria, else are excluded from the criteria.

type.description: The type of SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Malware rule

id.description: System-generated identifier for a SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Malware rule

order.description: Order of rule execution with respect to other SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning Malware rules

cloudAppTenants.description: Name-ID pairs of the cloud application tenants for which the rule is applied. If the name-ID pairs of the cloud application tenants are not specified, the rule is applied to all tenants.

action.description: The configured action for the policy rule

quarantineLocation.description: Location where all the quarantined files are moved and necessary actions are taken by either deleting or restoring the data

scanInboundEmailLink.description: Enables or disables the scan inbound email link

lastModifiedTime.description: Timestamp of when the rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy.description: Admin user that last modified the rule

accessControl.description: Access privilege of this rule based on the admin's Role Based Authorization (RBA) state

casbEmailLabel.description: Name-ID of the email label associated with the rule

buckets.description: The buckets for the Zscaler service to inspect for sensitive data

labels.description: Name-ID pairs of rule labels associated with the rule

casbTombstoneTemplate.description: Name-ID of the quarantine tombstone template associated with the rule

includeCompanyDomains.description: A Boolean flag to determine if the organizational domains have to be included in the domain profile

includeSubdomains.description: A Boolean flag to determine whether or not to include subdomains

description.description: Additional notes or information about the domain profile

customDomains.description: List of custom domains for the domain profile. There can be one or more custom domains.

predefinedEmailDomains.description: List of predefined email service provider domains for the domain profile

description.description: The text that is included in the tombstone file

labelColor.description: Color to apply to the email label

labelDeleted.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether or not the email label is deleted

tenantId.description: Tenant ID to which the tag belongs

deleted.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether or not a tag is deleted

tagUUID.description: Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the tag

lastTenantValidationTime.description: Timestamp of when the scan was last validated

id.description: A unique identifier for an entity

name.description: The configured name of the entity

externalId.description: An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

EntityReference.description: This is an immutable reference to an entity that mainly consists of an ID and name

name.description: Name of the DLP rule object type defined in the criteria

cur_scan_start_time.description: The SaaS Security scan start time. A scan starts running when the initialization is completed successfully.

prev_scan_end_time.description: Timestamp of when the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning policies for a tenant were last scanned

accessToken.description: The access token issued to the SaaS tenant application by the authorization serverfor tenant authorization

id.description: The unique identifier for a DLP server.

ICAPServer.description: DLP server (i.e., servers using ICAP) information.
